scope: actual visual inspection of each of four native 2560x1440 frames

images.observations: One blue robot body with white roof sensor; blue rotated box and orange cylinder are distinct. Actor unit additionally shows one red box advancing across the scene. No visible model duplication, robot-obstacle overlap, image clipping, or malformed geometry.
images.limitations: Top-down RGB alone cannot determine wheel support height or TF alignment; those require native body/contact/transform records.
